product_family: Sharly AI - single AI research/document assistant product (summarize, compare, cite, chat across documents) sold in tiered plans: Free, Pro, Team, and Business/Enterprise, with the Business tier adding SSO/SAML, admin controls, audit logs, and "private deployments"

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: "SOC 2 Type II" appears only as an unlinked bullet point under a "Get compliance ready" / security feature list on the Business-tier pricing and product pages. No audit report, auditor name, badge, or trust-center link substantiates the claim anywhere on the domain, and no independent trust portal (Vanta/Drata/SafeBase) could be found for Sharly AI.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: ISO 27001 is not mentioned on the security-and-privacy page, product page, pricing page, or in web search results for the domain.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an explicit GDPR compliance statement, EU representative, or DPA link on any accessible vendor page. The vendor's own /privacy legal page exists but its full text could not be rendered by automated tooling (client-rendered app shell only), so GDPR posture could not be directly confirmed from the policy text itself.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: HIPAA, BAA, or PHI handling is not mentioned on any accessible vendor page (security-and-privacy, product, pricing, or use-cases).

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence and not obviously applicable; no direct card-payment handling claims found (billing is likely handled by a third-party processor, unconfirmed).

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on any accessible vendor page.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on any accessible vendor page.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on any accessible vendor page.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor's own security page states broadly: 'Sharly employs models that strictly prohibit the use of input data for any model re-training purposes,' with no visible free-vs-paid carve-out on that page. However, an independent third-party summary associated the 'no training' guarantee specifically with paid plans, which could not be corroborated or ruled out directly on sharly.ai because the full legal privacy policy text was not renderable by automated tooling. Treat the free-tier training posture as unconfirmed.
privacy.data_region: Not specified on any accessible page. "Data residency" is listed only as an unelaborated Business-tier feature bullet on the pricing/product pages, with no named regions or hosting locations disclosed.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 for data and chats at rest

security.name: Access control
security.value: Row-level access controls segregating data by workspace and organization; role-based permissions on Team/Business plans

security.name: SSO / SAML
security.value: SSO/SAML available on the Business plan

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Data is automatically deleted if the account is inactive for over 30 days

security.name: PII handling
security.value: System scans for personally identifiable information in real time and removes it

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: Activity logs / audit logs track operations for accountability; version history available on Business plan

security.name: Scoped answer mode
security.value: "Docs-only" answer mode restricts responses to only the user's uploaded documents, keeping reasoning private

products.name: Sharly AI (Free / Pro / Team)
products.data_scope: User-uploaded documents and connected sources (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, links, Google Docs, Notion)
products.notes: No SSO, no admin/audit-log features documented; standard AES-256/TLS 1.3 encryption applies across tiers per vendor claims.

products.name: Sharly AI Business
products.data_scope: Same document/source scope as lower tiers, plus team workspaces and shared knowledge
products.notes: Adds admin dashboard, role-based access, version history/audit logs, SSO/SAML, and "private deployments." Also the only tier where the unverified 'SOC 2 Type II' bullet and 'data residency' are listed as features.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS: Free; Pro ~$12.50/seat/mo (billed yearly); Team ~$24/seat/mo up to 100 seats (billed yearly); Business is custom-priced, contact sales
compare.data_residency: Marketed as a Business-tier feature; specific regions/hosting locations not publicly disclosed

flags: 'SOC 2 Type II' is listed as a bare feature bullet on the /product and /pricing pages (Business tier) with no trust center, no audit report, no auditor name, and no badge anywhere on the domain, and no listing on any third-party trust-center directory (Vanta, Drata, SafeBase).
No dedicated trust/security center exists; compliance claims are scattered marketing bullets rather than a documented, auditable program.

Full text of the /privacy and /terms legal pages could not be rendered by automated tooling (the site serves a client-rendered app shell for these routes), so GDPR posture, DPA availability, and any sub-processor list could not be directly verified from the policy text itself despite the pages existing.

Possible tier-based inconsistency in the 'no training on customer data' claim: the vendor's own security page states a blanket no-retraining policy, but an independent third-party summary associated the no-training guarantee specifically with paid plans; the free-tier training posture is unconfirmed.
"Private deployments" on the Business tier is ambiguous marketing language; it was not confirmed whether this means true on-prem/VPC self-hosting or simply a dedicated multi-tenant cloud instance.
